passages.provision_quote: Sales of safe firearm storage devices.
passages.note: Bill text creates a TPT sales-tax exemption for safe firearm storage devices; it does not regulate ownership, sale, or carry of firearms.
Bill-status page lists Gress as prime sponsor of HB2635, a firearm-storage-device tax exemption bill.
House Third Reading; Gress voted Y on a near-unanimous (57-0-3-0-0) passage of the same tax-exemption bill.

rows.reasoning: HB2635 creates a transaction-privilege-tax exemption for safe firearm storage devices; Gress is its prime sponsor and voted Yea on House Third Reading. The gun-policy ladder asks how government should regulate firearm ownership, weapon types, background checks, and carry; a storage-device tax exemption matches none of those clauses, so the evidence is adjacent and establishes no chair.
